title: Career cities Part 8: Asia, part three, with Ledger in under 2 minutes
summary: Part 8 of the career cities series covers 9 niche hubs across south asia, the gulf and central asia, one sourced fact and the jobs available at each stop, as Hoang asked on 15 Nov.

caption:
Career cities with Ledger, Part 8, is the last trip across Asia, through South Asia, Central Asia and the Gulf, with 9 stops, and each stop shows one niche industry that town is a hub for, with a sourced fact and the jobs you could have there

So you will meet Bengaluru, Tiruppur, Colombo, Dhaka, Surat, Sialkot, Almaty, Dubai, and Ras Laffan

Save the map for later, because Part 9 maps career cities across South America
